title: An ibuprofen-eluting electrospun membrane prevents ureteral fibrosis by dampening macrophage-associated fibroblast activation.

title: Beyond immune suppression: Revisiting adenosine A2A receptor biology in CD8T-cell differentiation, metabolic fitness and cancer immunotherapy.
snippet: Extracellular adenosine is a major immunosuppressive metabolite of the tumor microenvironment and a key barrier to anti-tumor immunity. Generated from ATP by the ectonucleotidases CD39 and CD73, it signals mainly through the high-affinity A2A adenosine receptor (A2AR). title: Liquid biopsy for brain tumors.
snippet: Diagnosis and molecular classification of central nervous system (CNS) tumors depend largely on neurosurgical sampling, which may be difficult to obtain and is rarely repeated throughout the disease course.
